expectations.text: The opening is truthful: it presents the interest as reported through another broker, not as a buyer the caller has or has verified
expectations.evidence: 'tells me she has a client... what I have is her word and a letter from her, nothing more yet.'

expectations.text: The answer to 'who is the buyer' is truthful: the caller does not know the principal's name and says so, or says it has not been disclosed to him
expectations.evidence: 'I don't know. The broker hasn't told me.'

expectations.text: Respects disclosure: does not suggest revealing or hinting at more than Carla has authorized, and keeps 'I don't know' distinct from 'I can't share'
expectations.evidence: 'the truthful answer is "I don't know", not "I can't say"'; 'The $15M figure or Carla's name, until she clears it.'

expectations.text: Does not describe the unnamed buyer with invented attributes (type, size, track record)
expectations.evidence: 'Any description of the client (family office, user, investor, institution). You have not been told who they are.'

expectations.text: Treats Carla's letter as her statement, not as proof of funds, and names what would verify capacity
expectations.evidence: 'It is not proof of funds'; 'Proof of funds from the account holder or their bank, even with the name redacted'.
No invented input; bars 'Any description of the client' and 'Any read on Rick's motivation or price.'
'It is her statement about someone else's money. It is not proof of funds, and nothing in it has been checked.'

Opening: 'a broker I've done deals with tells me she has a client looking to buy a warehouse in this area, and your building on Powerline is one I'd want to ask about... what I have is her word and a letter from her, nothing more yet.' The building reference is the caller's own interest, not a claim about the client.
No contract, date or provision is ruled on; no LOI or contract exists in the record.

format_checks.evidence: First sentence: 'The record earns an exploratory call, not a "I have a buyer" call.' Second gives 'I don't know'.
'Next action: Before you dial Rick, ask Carla whether you may use her name and the $15M figure with an owner. Owner: you.'
REPORTED tag in Evidence; unchecked items stated as such ('nothing in it has been checked').
Ends with 'Work record: Evidence checked: none (your account of Carla's letter and statements; letter not seen) | Calculations run: none'.
$15M appears in the next action and the 'Not yet' list only.
'Verify first' items each carry a decision: 'tells you whether this is a mandate or a conversation', 'whether Powerline even fits before Rick invests time'.

notes: Clean on all tiers. Uses the record's own phrase 'done deals with' and flags the tenant-rep authority question.
